payload.label: Customer Follow-Up
payload.description: Track customer lifecycle steps, product customer targets, evidence references, and follow-up actions without owning CRM, email, calendar, payment, access, or content truth.

payload.authority_contract: This record is only a package-local display projection over caller-owned contact identity. CRM or contact-owner packages remain the identity authority.
This package tracks the product customer target. Product offer, pricing, payment, and access truth stay with their owner packages.

payload.evidence_contract: evidenceRefs point at content, distribution, checkout, CRM, calendar, access, analytics, or support records; this package never copies those owners' truth.
payload.step_contract: Purchase, onboarding, follow-up, and feedback are lifecycle evidence rows. Real checkout/payment/access/customer identity facts remain with their owner packages.

payload.name: customer-follow-up-record-step
payload.description: Write one customer lifecycle step with product, evidence, and owner references.

payload.name: send-account-onboarding-from-claim
payload.description: Second half of the exactly-once welcome pipeline: given a won account-delivery-claim (account_id + idempotency_key), resolve the account's controlled email via account-contact-points.resolve-email-contact-point (email never enters the event log), then dispatch the generic resend-email-sender.send-templated-email-from-bound-event with idempotencyKey=<idempotency_key> (Resend header dedup = external exactly-once, covers trigger observation-replay). Fail-closed: no resolved address -> the send step is skipped (no email to an empty address). No god package: resolve lives in account-contact-points, send in resend-email-sender; this action only orchestrates.

payload.name: claim-welcome-for-contact
payload.description: Pipeline ENTRY: when an account first becomes contactable (an account-email-contact-point record is written locally at signup), attempt the once-per-account welcome claim. Owns the welcome POLICY (grain = <account_id>:welcome, purpose=welcome, template=account-onboarding) and delegates the exactly-once barrier to the GENERIC account-contact-points.claim-delivery-once (CAS create-only). Only the first attempt per account writes the account-delivery-claim record -> its delta fires trigger B -> resolve+send. Grants are admitted to the EXTERNAL check-license-online authority (not the envelope log), so this LOCAL contact-point delta is the correct trigger point, not the grant event.

payload.name: publish-welcome-chat-from-claim
payload.description: Given a won welcome delivery claim, publish the outbound follow-up chat turn by writing the conversations-contracted addressed-exchange attribute facts (the DATA seam; conversations' record-projection descriptor is maintained:true so materialization follows the facts). No dispatch to action:publish-addressed-exchange-conversations - that def carries value_to_bytes:json/object_rows, unsupported by workflow-core value_to_bytes.rs:106 (cell_table only): latent conversations-lane defect, dead code path removed (L030).
